description: Python services shipped as Docker images, built with uv in a builder stage and run on the python image.

packageRules.description: Pin exact versions in pyproject.toml. With a bare '>=' floor Renovate never classifies an update, so new majors land silently inside lock-file maintenance; and with a floor uv may resolve a release younger than minimumReleaseAge, failing the PR with 'Artifact update problem'. Safe because these apps ship as images, not to PyPI. A repo publishing a library overrides this for that package file.
requires-python is support policy (CI matrix and base images), not a dependency.

The uv builder creates the venv under lib/pythonX.Y and the runtime stage copies it, so both images must share the Python minor: one PR moves them together. Held below 3.14; a repo raises allowedVersions to adopt it.
Read the Python version out of the uv image's compound tag (python3.13-trixie-slim) so it moves in step with the python image.
